### A central repository of digital pathology slides to boost the development of artificial intelligence
<p>[Learn more »](https://bigpicture.eu){style="font-size:larger;"}</p>
:::
::: g-col-5
![](/images/bp-logo.png)
:::

This webpage links relevant entry points of interest for different usage.

### Datasets

[Browse - Landing pages website root](https://datasets.bp.nbis.se/)

[Demo Search - Federated Discovery search service interface ](https://bp-demo.rahtiapp.fi/)

[Download - Data download request service](datasets/download/downloading-data.html)

[Submit - Data submission tools and instructions](datasets/submission/)

### Algorithms (upcoming)
Browse - AI algorithm register / download service

Try - Service for indirect access to AI algorithm

Benchmark - Service for indirect access to datasets

Submit - Algorithm submission entry points

### Compute (upcoming)

Analysis - Request Services for on-platform data use such as Cytomine

AI training - Guidance on how to procure on-platform GPU HPC resources

### Software
[Cytomine documentation](https://doc.cytomine.com/)

### Metrics
[Numbers from the repository](https://bp.nbis.se/metrics/)

[Archive status](https://grafana.bp.nbis.se/public-dashboards/c465fe145d7844b59d7eea87be8e199d)

:::

## Digital pathology slides for AI research

::: {.fu-lead}
BigPicture collects whole-slide images from hospitals and labs across Europe, so
researchers can build and test AI for pathology. Pick what you want to do.
:::

## What brings you here?

::: {.fu-lead}
BigPicture is a European archive of digital pathology slides for AI research.
Choose what fits you, and we'll show you the steps.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 🔬 I want to use data

```{=html}
<ol class="fu-steps">
  <li><strong>Find a dataset</strong>
    Look through the collections and pick one that fits your research.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="https://datasets.bp.nbis.se/">Browse datasets</a>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="https://bp-demo.rahtiapp.fi/">Search (demo)</a></li>
  <li><strong>Ask for access</strong>
    Apply for the dataset in REMS. A data access committee reviews your request.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="https://bp-rems.sd.csc.fi/">Apply in REMS</a></li>
  <li><strong>Download it</strong>
    Once approved, download the encrypted files with the <code>sda-cli</code> tool.
    This step needs some comfort with the command line.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="datasets/download/downloading-data.html">Download guide</a></li>
</ol>
```

## 🏥 I want to share data

```{=html}
<ol class="fu-steps">
  <li><strong>Get your site on board</strong>
    Your organisation needs an agreement with BigPicture and accounts for the people who upload.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="datasets/submission/index.html">Before you start</a></li>
  <li><strong>Learn the words</strong>
    A short glossary of the terms you'll meet: model, mappers, bundle, staging.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="datasets/submission/key-concepts.html">Key concepts</a></li>
  <li><strong>Hand over to your technical team</strong>
    Converting and uploading slides is done by an IT or data person, following a step-by-step manual.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="datasets/submission/index.html#choose-your-path">Choose a submission path</a></li>
</ol>
```

## 📊 I'm curious what's inside

```{=html}
<ol class="fu-steps">
  <li><strong>See the numbers</strong>
    Slides, datasets and contributing partners, updated from the archive.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="metrics/index.html">Metrics dashboard</a></li>
  <li><strong>Look at the collections</strong>
    Every dataset has a public landing page describing it.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="https://datasets.bp.nbis.se/">Browse datasets</a></li>
  <li><strong>Read about the project</strong>
    Who is behind BigPicture and why.<br>
    <a class="fu-btn" href="https://bigpicture.eu">bigpicture.eu</a></li>
</ol>
```

## 🤖 I build algorithms

```{=html}
<p class="fu-lead fu-muted">Coming later: an algorithm register, a way to try models
on BigPicture data without downloading it, benchmarks, and on-platform compute for
training. For now, start with <em>I want to use data</em>.</p>
<a class="fu-btn" href="algorithms/index.html">What's planned</a>
```

:::
